climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Côte de Nuits village in Burgundy, around 96% red from Pinot Noir and a little white from Chardonnay. It holds five Grand Cru vineyards, including Clos de Tart, Clos des Lambrays, Clos Saint-Denis and Clos de la Roche.
